facts.text: Ansion was a grassland planet in the Mid Rim near Vortex and Bilbringi, located on the Namadii Corridor.

evidence.quote: Ansion was a grassland planet in the Mid Rim near Vortex and Bilbringi, located on the Namadii Corridor.

facts.text: Discovered sometime after 3000 BBY and before the Galactic Republic's Ruusan Reformation, the world joined the Galactic Senate and maintained a relatively humble existence within the government.

evidence.quote: Discovered sometime after 3000 BBY and before the Galactic Republic's Ruusan Reformation, the world joined the Galactic Senate and maintained a relatively humble existence within the government.

facts.text: Represented in the Senate by Senator Mousul during the Separatist Crisis, Ansion was being eyed by Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai, for if it could be made to secede, the other worlds tied to it could also fall to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

evidence.quote: Represented in the Senate by Senator Mousul during the Separatist Crisis, Ansion was being eyed by Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai, for if it could be made to secede, the other worlds tied to it could also fall to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

facts.text: Inciting a border dispute between the Unity of Community government and the nomadic Alwari, Presidente Mai began to strain the world's relationship with the other signers of the treaty.

evidence.quote: Inciting a border dispute between the Unity of Community government and the nomadic Alwari, Presidente Mai began to strain the world's relationship with the other signers of the treaty.

facts.text: The Separatists hired local Bossban Soergg the Hutt to help induce riots and conflict between the Ansari and the Unity Council, but when the Jedi appeared, he was forced to turn to more brutal techniques.

evidence.quote: The Separatists hired local Bossban Soergg the Hutt to help induce riots and conflict between the Ansari and the Unity Council, but when the Jedi appeared, he was forced to turn to more brutal techniques.

facts.text: Hiring thugs to track the Jedi, his men harried the four peacekeepers into the foothills, where they found shelter among the native tribesmen.

evidence.quote: Hiring thugs to track the Jedi, his men harried the four peacekeepers into the foothills, where they found shelter among the native tribesmen.

facts.text: Eventually the Jedi were able to restore peace between both nations and the Unity Council voted to remain with the Republic.

evidence.quote: Eventually the Jedi were able to restore peace between both nations and the Unity Council voted to remain with the Republic.

facts.text: Padawan Offee confronted Soergg the Hutt with evidence that he was connected with the Separatists, but all evidence was circumstantial and no charges were brought against him.

evidence.quote: Padawan Offee confronted Soergg the Hutt with evidence that he was connected with the Separatists, but all evidence was circumstantial and no charges were brought against him.

facts.text: Joining the Galactic Empire following its rise from the ashes of the Republic, Emperor Palpatine appointed a Moff who dissolved all existing treaties and alliances, guaranteeing that a threat to Imperial security could not arise amongst the obscure worlds.

evidence.quote: Joining the Galactic Empire following its rise from the ashes of the Republic, Emperor Palpatine appointed a Moff who dissolved all existing treaties and alliances, guaranteeing that a threat to Imperial security could not arise amongst the obscure worlds.

facts.text: Shortly after Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire prepared a massive attack on Ansion, a civilian target.

evidence.quote: Shortly after Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire prepared a massive attack on Ansion, a civilian target.

facts.text: The Empire suspected the planet's population of harboring Alliance assets or at least Rebel sympathizers.

evidence.quote: The Empire suspected the planet's population of harboring Alliance assets or at least Rebel sympathizers.

facts.text: Information on the preemptive strike was retrieved by Lieutenant Deena Shan during the attack on Bannistar Station.

evidence.quote: Information on the preemptive strike was retrieved by Lieutenant Deena Shan during the attack on Bannistar Station.

facts.text: In response, Admiral Ackbar sent fighter squadrons, including Dagger Squadron, to the Ansion system to warn their allies of the impending assault.

evidence.quote: In response, Admiral Ackbar sent fighter squadrons, including Dagger Squadron, to the Ansion system to warn their allies of the impending assault.

facts.text: Taken by Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo during his northern campaign, the world was overrun by the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War and its inhabitants enslaved.

evidence.quote: Taken by Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo during his northern campaign, the world was overrun by the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War and its inhabitants enslaved.

facts.text: Freed by the Imperial Remnant in 29 ABY, the world remained in Imperial space throughout the Second Galactic Civil War.

evidence.quote: Freed by the Imperial Remnant in 29 ABY, the world remained in Imperial space throughout the Second Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: Ansion was a world of rolling plains, grassy fields, and wide valleys.

evidence.quote: Ansion was a world of rolling plains, grassy fields, and wide valleys.

facts.text: Due to the high winds that swept the planet's surface, the extensive animal life on the world adapted to ride the winds or withstand it on the ground.

evidence.quote: Due to the high winds that swept the planet's surface, the extensive animal life on the world adapted to ride the winds or withstand it on the ground.

facts.text: Mammals such as the mountable suubatar and sadain, the domesticated surepp, the enormous lorqual and the predatory shanh, were all built with thick hides and strong legs to propel them along the windswept grasslands.

evidence.quote: Mammals such as the mountable suubatar and sadain, the domesticated surepp, the enormous lorqual and the predatory shanh, were all built with thick hides and strong legs to propel them along the windswept grasslands.

facts.text: Other bizarre creatures include the water-dwelling, community-minded gairk, which captured unwitting victims by working in succinct with other members of its species.

evidence.quote: Other bizarre creatures include the water-dwelling, community-minded gairk, which captured unwitting victims by working in succinct with other members of its species.

facts.text: Plant life on the world was largely limited to low-standing shrubs and grasses, though there were small stands of trees dotting the landscape.

evidence.quote: Plant life on the world was largely limited to low-standing shrubs and grasses, though there were small stands of trees dotting the landscape.

facts.text: A uniquely adapted creature was the tumbleweed-like plant called the chawix, which used its many spiky growths to impale its prey as the wind carried it.

evidence.quote: A uniquely adapted creature was the tumbleweed-like plant called the chawix, which used its many spiky growths to impale its prey as the wind carried it.

facts.text: Aside from the plains, volcanic vents often times opened up on the surface, billowing ash and smoke into the sky.

evidence.quote: Aside from the plains, volcanic vents often times opened up on the surface, billowing ash and smoke into the sky.
